display_text: Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot) ** [[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +4]][[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +4]] : Provides a +4 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +6 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.[[Category: Sneak Attack Bonus items/+4]] → [[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +5]][[Sneak Attack Bonus| Sneak Attack Bonus +5]] : Provides a +5 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +8 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.[[Category: Sneak Attack Bonus items/+5]] ** Adds [[Spell Lore|Void Lore V]][[Spell Lore|Void Lore V]]: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 15% [[Equipment bonus]] to their chance to critical hit.[[Category:Void Lore V items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
